policy._why: 13 weeks is the point where pages become markedly more likely to lose AI citations, and recency is the strongest single correlate of being cited. The ceiling is refresh capacity times that window: publish faster than the library can be maintained and the tail ages out of citability.

_capacity_derivation.note: Average over the observed authoring window - first registry commit to last registry commit - floored. The best single interval is a bulk authoring event and is deliberately not used. The window closes at the last authoring event rather than at today so the figure is a function of committed history and not of the clock; see window_close_choice in reports/cadence/capacity-derivation.json.
